generator.program.note: The lineage's own program (growth plan G2.3a), on the broadleaf base: it gives the values its species leave unset, which the broadleaf program gave as defaults until then.

traits.note: Hutchinson (vol. 1, 2nd ed., 1959), family 70 Moraceae: trees or shrubs, rarely herbs, with milky juice; leaves alternate, rarely opposite, simple; stipules two, often falling and leaving a scar; flowers tiny, crowded in heads, disks or hollow receptacles (the fig); calyx lobes usually 4, sometimes reduced or none, no petals; ovary of 2 carpels, one often undeveloped. The fruits of a head ripen together into one (a fig, a mulberry): the fruit type multiple.
